independent_root_cause_review.producer_contract: Specialist validates claim_id and task_id uniqueness only inside one program_cell_id.

independent_root_cause_review.writer_contract: Writer builds global raw-string Claim and WWC maps, so a later Cell overwrites an earlier Cell before section lineage validation.
independent_root_cause_review.verifier_contract: Verifier receives the downstream assembled surfaces and therefore must consume the same scoped identity contract rather than infer Cell ownership from a raw local ID.
